description: This file defines an enum FuelAutoTune that implements the FuelAutoLogic interface. It includes methods for processing fuel autotuning data, optimizing fuel tables, and calculating deviations based on AFR data points. The class is part of a package related to automapping and tuning in an automotive ECU software system.

classes.name: FuelAutoTune
classes.description: An enum singleton implementing fuel auto-tuning logic, including methods for processing and optimizing AFR maps based on ECU data points.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Main method performing the fuel auto-tune process by optimizing the fuel map based on collection of AFR data points and target AFR.

methods.name: getTotalDeviationAfterCellOptimization
methods.description: Optimizes a single cell (pressure and RPM index) of the fuel map to minimize deviation from target AFR.

methods.name: countDeviation
methods.description: Calculates the deviation of AFR data points from the target across the entire map.

methods.name: smooth
methods.description: Applies smoothing to the deviation grid to stabilize adjustments.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Outputs log messages to standard out.
